name: event-medallion
title: Event Medallion (Streaming Bronze / Silver / Gold)
description: Architecture blueprint that applies medallion layering to streaming data: live events land in an Eventhouse (raw/Bronze), get progressively refined into cleansed and aggregated layers across the Eventhouse and a Lakehouse, and serve both real-time and historical views. Best when you need medallion-style quality gates AND up-to-the-second data.
best_for: Streaming workloads that also need layered, reproducible refinement (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and both live + historical serving — the medallion pattern applied to an event pipeline.
primary_storage: Eventhouse / KQL Database (hot, raw+refined) + Lakehouse (cold, curated Gold)
key_ingestion: Eventstream (streaming) into Bronze; Copy Job / Pipeline for batch backfill

item_set.purpose: Hot store for raw (Bronze) + refined (Silver) event data
KQL tables + update policies driving Bronze->Silver refinement
Cold store for curated Gold (Delta) + historical retention
Ingest + route live events into the Bronze KQL table
Batch backfill + orchestrate Silver->Gold export to the lakehouse
Gold aggregation into the lakehouse (Direct Lake ready)

options: Silver in KQL, Gold in Lakehouse
decisions.guidance: Keep refinement in KQL for pure low-latency serving; export Gold to a Lakehouse when you need Direct Lake BI or long-term Delta history.
Update policies transform on ingestion (lowest latency); materialized views for incremental aggregates; querysets for ad-hoc.
KQL Dashboard for sub-minute live views; Report for modeled historical Gold.

build_with.deploy_ordering: Eventhouse + KQLDatabase + Lakehouse (Foundation) before Eventstream (Ingestion) before transforms and dashboards; fabio deploy handles ordering.
outline: Create the hot store (eventhouse + kql-database) and the cold store (lakehouse).
Create the Bronze KQL table + an eventstream that lands events into it (see workflow rti-pipeline).
Add Bronze->Silver KQL update policies / materialized views for refinement.
Export/aggregate Silver->Gold into the lakehouse via a notebook + pipeline.
Build a Real-Time Dashboard (hot) and a Report over Gold (cold); add an Activator for alerts.
